# Config reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_config_reference.py from the field metadata in
     src/neural_trade/core/config.py. Do not edit by hand: change the metadata and re-run the script. -->

Every field of `neural_trade.core.config.Config`: 112 fields, 35 tunable, 7 deprecated. Keys are flat (`configs/default.yaml`, `--set KEY=VALUE`). `Config.validate` refuses a value outside its range or choices; a range on a list or mapping applies to each number in it. **Tunable** marks what a sweep may search; **deprecated** marks a legacy field kept so old config files still load. Registry keys are checked against the registries when they load (`registries.load_all`), not here.

## Units

| unit | meaning |
|---|---|
| `bars` | bars of the (resampled) price series |
| `minutes` | wall-clock minutes |
| `sequences` | input windows (one sequence per anchor bar) |
| `epochs` | training epochs |
| `steps` | optimizer steps (training batches) |
| `count` | a plain count |
| `fraction` | a share between 0 and 1 |
| `bps` | basis points (1/10,000 of the price) |
| `weight` | a dimensionless multiplier of a loss term |
| `dimensionless` | a dimensionless number |
| `scaled` | target-scaler units (the standardised price delta) |
| `scaled^2` | squared target-scaler units (a variance) |
| `quote` | quote currency of the instrument (USDT on the reference setup) |
| `index` | a position in a list (negative counts from the end) |
| `seed` | a random seed |
| `flag` | true or false |
| `name` | one of the listed names |
| `key` | a registry key or a Config field name, checked when the registries load |
| `path` | a file or directory path |
| `mapping` | a nested mapping (see the doc) |

## data

| name | default | unit | range or choices | tunable | deprecated | doc |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CSV_PATH` | `"binance_btcusdt_1min_ccxt.csv"` | path |  | no | no | OHLCV CSV (timestamp/datetime, open..volume) |
| `LOOKBACK` | `60` | bars | [1, 1440] | no | no | input window length in bars |
| `WINDOW_STEP` | `1` | bars | >= 1 | no | no | stride between consecutive training windows |
| `RESAMPLE_MINUTES` | `1` | minutes | >= 1 | no | no | aggregate to coarser bars (1 = native minute bars); not tunable until NT-040, because the annualisation ignores the bar size until then |
| `MAX_SEQUENCE_COUNT` | `53280` | sequences | >= 0 | no | no | keep only the most recent N sequences (0 = keep all) |
| `VAL_FRACTION` | `0.066` | fraction | (0, 0.5) | no | no | validation block size (fraction of sequences) |
| `CAL_FRACTION` | `0.066` | fraction | (0, 0.5) | no | no | calibration block size (fraction of sequences) |
| `N_FOLDS` | `5` | count | >= 2 | no | no | TimeSeriesSplit folds; the last fold's test block is reported |
| `FOLD_INDEX` | `-1` | index |  | no | no | which purged fold to train/evaluate on (-1 = the latest; walk-forward varies it) |

## training

| name | default | unit | range or choices | tunable | deprecated | doc |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `BATCH_SIZE` | `256` | count | [16, 2048] (log scale) | yes | no | 256: a step costs about the same at 64 or 256 on the GPU (launch-bound), so ~3.7x faster epochs |
| `EPOCHS` | `20` | epochs | >= 1 | no | no | maximum training epochs; EarlyStopping (EARLY) may stop sooner, and the best-validation epoch is served (D-011) |
| `LR` | `0.001` | dimensionless | (0, 1] (log scale) | yes | no | main optimizer learning rate |
| `PATIENCE` | `3` | epochs | >= 0 | yes | no | ReduceLROnPlateau patience (was EPOCHS: disabled) |
| `EARLY` | `6` | epochs | >= 0 | no | no | EarlyStopping patience on val_loss (was EPOCHS: disabled) |
| `TRAIN_METRICS_EVERY` | `10` | steps | >= 1 | no | no | update the training-set diagnostics every N steps (1 = every step); the training loss and all validation metrics are always exact |

## calibration

| name | default | unit | range or choices | tunable | deprecated | doc |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DAMPING` | `0.5` | dimensionless | [0, 1] | no | yes | legacy alias; use CALIB_DAMPING |
| `CALIB_WARMUP_FRACTION` | `0.05` | fraction | [0, 1] | no | no | warm-up forward passes (fraction of an epoch) |
| `CALIB_SAMPLE_FRACTION` | `0.1` | fraction | [0, 1] | no | no | loss-magnitude sampling (fraction of an epoch) |
| `CALIB_LAMBDA_MIN` | `0.1` | weight | >= 0 | no | no | lower clamp of every loss weight the calibration pass rescales |
| `CALIB_LAMBDA_MAX` | `20.0` | weight | > 0 | no | no | upper clamp of every loss weight the calibration pass rescales |
| `CALIB_DAMPING` | `1.0` | dimensionless | [0, 1] | no | no | 0 = no change, 1 = full magnitude equalisation |
| `CALIB_DAMPING_POINT` | `null` | dimensionless | [0, 1]; null allowed | no | no | damping of the point-loss weights LAMBDA_SHORT, LAMBDA_POINT and LAMBDA_LONG (None = CALIB_DAMPING) |
| `CALIB_DAMPING_TREND` | `0.0` | dimensionless | [0, 1]; null allowed | no | no | 0: the trend prior is a regulariser, not rescaled |
| `CALIB_DAMPING_DIR` | `null` | dimensionless | [0, 1]; null allowed | no | no | damping of LAMBDA_DIR (None = CALIB_DAMPING) |
| `CALIB_DAMPING_VAR` | `null` | dimensionless | [0, 1]; null allowed | no | no | damping of LAMBDA_VAR (None = CALIB_DAMPING) |
| `CALIB_DAMPING_CRPS` | `null` | dimensionless | [0, 1]; null allowed | no | no | damping of LAMBDA_CRPS, rescaled only when it is > 0 (None = CALIB_DAMPING) |
| `CALIB_DAMPING_ECE` | `null` | dimensionless | [0, 1]; null allowed | no | no | damping of LAMBDA_SOFT_ECE, rescaled only when it is > 0 (None = CALIB_DAMPING) |
| `CALIB_DAMPING_VOL` | `null` | dimensionless | [0, 1]; null allowed | no | no | damping of LAMBDA_VOL (None = CALIB_DAMPING) |
| `CALIB_DAMPING_PHYSICS` | `0.0` | dimensionless | [0, 1]; null allowed | no | no | 0: bounded physics regularisers are never rescaled |
| `CALIB_OUTER` | `false` | flag |  | no | no | also calibrate the outer group multipliers |
| `DELTA_SHRINKAGE` | `true` | flag |  | no | no | serve beta x price-head delta, beta = clip(E[yd]/E[d^2], 0, 1) on the calibration block |
| `CONFORMAL_SCALE` | `"realized_vol"` | name | one of realized_vol, sigma, none | no | no | conformal interval scale: 'realized_vol' (window), 'sigma' (variance head) or 'none' |

## loss_weights

| name | default | unit | range or choices | tunable | deprecated | doc |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `LAMBDA_LOCAL_TREND` | `1.0` | weight | >= 0 | no | yes | retired term (always 0 in the objective) |
| `LAMBDA_GLOBAL_TREND` | `1.0` | weight | >= 0 | no | yes | retired term (always 0 in the objective) |
| `LAMBDA_EXTENDED_TREND` | `0.1` | weight | >= 0 | yes | no | momentum prior; a regulariser, kept small |
| `LAMBDA_QUANTILE` | `1.0` | weight | >= 0 | no | yes | unused (no quantile term in the objective) |
| `LAMBDA_SHORT` | `1.0` | weight | >= 0 | yes | no | point loss weight, h0 |
| `LAMBDA_POINT` | `1.0` | weight | >= 0 | yes | no | point loss weight, h1 |
| `LAMBDA_LONG` | `1.0` | weight | >= 0 | yes | no | point loss weight, h2 |
| `LAMBDA_DIR` | `1.0` | weight | >= 0 | yes | no | direction loss (DIRECTION_LOSS), summed over the horizons |
| `LAMBDA_INTER` | `1.0` | weight | >= 0 | yes | no | weight of model.losses (layer regularisers) |
| `LAMBDA_VOL` | `1.0` | weight | >= 0 | yes | no | prediction-spread vs target-spread penalty |
| `LAMBDA_VAR` | `1.0` | weight | >= 0 | yes | no | Gaussian NLL of the variance heads |
| `LAMBDA_TREND_OUTER` | `1.0` | weight | >= 0 | yes | no | outer multiplier of the summed extended-trend terms; rescaled by the calibration pass only with CALIB_OUTER |
| `LAMBDA_DIR_OUTER` | `1.0` | weight | >= 0 | yes | no | outer multiplier of the direction loss (LAMBDA_DIR term); rescaled by the calibration pass only with CALIB_OUTER |
| `LAMBDA_DIR_ALIGN_OUTER` | `0.0` | weight | >= 0 | yes | no | direction head vs Gaussian readout alignment |
| `LAMBDA_COHERENCE` | `1.0` | weight | >= 0 | yes | no | weight of the cross-horizon coherence penalty (sign disagreement and magnitude ordering of the price heads) |
| `LAMBDA_NLL_OUTER` | `1.0` | weight | >= 0 | yes | no | outer multiplier of the variance-head NLL (LAMBDA_VAR term); rescaled by the calibration pass only with CALIB_OUTER |
| `LAMBDA_CRPS` | `1.0` | weight | >= 0 | yes | no | weight of the Gaussian CRPS of the price and variance heads, summed over the horizons (0 = off) |
| `LAMBDA_SOFT_ECE` | `1.0` | weight | >= 0 | yes | no | weight of the differentiable ECE of the direction heads, summed over the horizons (0 = off) |
| `LAMBDA_DIR_ALIGN` | `0.7` | weight | >= 0 | yes | no | inner weight of the alignment term |
